text.en: In which order are the capstone system's steps?

tr: Maskele, ara, bütçeye sığdır, prompt kur, cevap al, doğrula, kaydet
en: Mask, search, fit to the budget, build the prompt, get the answer, verify, log

explanation.tr: Her adım modülde ayrı ayrı görüldü.
explanation.en: Every step was seen separately in the module.

text.en: Why is the question masked before the search?

tr: Kişisel veri ne aramaya ne kayda ne modele gitsin diye
en: So that personal data goes neither to the search nor the log nor the model

explanation.en: The log showed `[EMAIL]`.

text.en: How does the two-stage search work?

tr: Önce en ilgili makale bulunur, sonra yalnızca onun cümleleri kaynak olur
en: The most relevant article is found first, then only its sentences become sources
The same search is run twice

explanation.tr: Makale düzeyinde arama 09'da ilk üçte %100 isabetliydi.
explanation.en: Article-level search was 100% accurate within the first three in 09.

text.tr: Kaynaklar neden bir token bütçesine göre sınırlandı?
text.en: Why were the sources limited by a token budget?

tr: Bağlam penceresine sığsın ve maliyet kontrol altında kalsın diye
en: So they fit the context window and the cost stays under control

explanation.en: The lesson of 07.

text.en: Which two things does verification check?

tr: Kaynak numarasının var olduğunu ve cevabın sayılarının o kaynakta geçtiğini
en: That the source number exists and that the answer's numbers appear in that source

explanation.en: The source check from 08.

text.tr: Doğrulama başarısız olunca kullanıcıya ne gider?
text.en: What goes to the user when verification fails?

en: The model's answer as it is

explanation.en: Instead of a made-up period.

text.en: How was the verification tested?

tr: Yanlış sayı içeren kayıtlı bir yanıt verilerek
en: By giving a recorded reply containing a wrong number

explanation.en: "5 years" was not in the source; the answer was rejected.

text.tr: Örnek okuyucu neden doğrulamayı hiç tetiklemez?
text.en: Why does the example reader never trigger the verification?

tr: Kaynağın cümlesini aynen kopyalar; yanlış sayı yazmaz
en: It copies the source's sentence as it is; it never writes a wrong number

explanation.tr: Gerçek modelde doğrulama daha da önemli.
explanation.en: With a real model verification matters even more.

text.tr: Bitirme sistemi temel düzenekle karşılaştırılınca ne oldu?
text.en: What happened when the capstone system was compared with the basic setup?

tr: Aynı doğru sayısı (15), yanlış 2'den 0'a indi, kaçırma 7'den 9'a çıktı
en: The same correct count (15), wrong fell from 2 to 0, misses rose from 7 to 9

explanation.tr: Cevabı olmayan üç sorunun üçünde de "bulamadım".
explanation.en: All three questions with no answer got "not found".

text.en: What is the capstone system's price?

tr: Birkaç kaçırma daha ve soru başına daha çok token (154'e karşı 132)
en: A few more misses and more tokens per question (154 against 132)

explanation.en: The sentences of a whole article are sent.

text.en: Which costs more in customer support?

en: Saying "not found" and passing to a human

explanation.tr: Bu yüzden yanlışı sıfırlayan sistem tercih edilebilir.
explanation.en: That is why the system that removes wrong answers may be preferred.

text.en: What is the limit of a comparison on 27 questions?

tr: İki soruluk fark küçüktür; karar için daha büyük küme gerekir
en: A difference of two questions is small; a decision needs a larger set

explanation.en: The resampling lesson from 11.

text.en: What causes most of the missed questions?

explanation.tr: Çare gömme ya da karma arama (09).
explanation.en: The remedy is embedding or hybrid search (09).

text.tr: Okuyucu gerçek bir modelle değiştirilirse değerlendirme nasıl değişir?
text.en: How does evaluation change if the reader is replaced by a real model?

tr: İfade eşleşmesi yetmez; insan ve model ile değerlendirme gerekir
en: Phrase matching is not enough; human and model-based evaluation is needed

explanation.en: The answers become free text.

text.tr: "Kaynakta yoksa söyle" davranışı prompt'la yetmiyorsa ne yapılabilir?
text.en: What can be done if the "say so if it is not in the source" behaviour cannot be had with the prompt?

explanation.en: Sections 12 and 13.

text.en: What does `DocQA.log` record?

tr: Maskelenmiş soruyu, doğrulama sonucunu, token'ı ve maliyeti
en: The masked question, the verification result, the tokens and the cost

explanation.en: The log is kept after masking.

text.en: What was the total example cost of the 27 questions?

explanation.en: The prices are the example prices from 07.

text.en: How is the system improved?

tr: Bileşenleri ayrı ayrı ölçülerek ve en büyük hata kaynağı düzeltilerek
en: By measuring its components separately and fixing the largest source of error

explanation.en: The error placement from 11.

text.tr: Bu bölümde model yerine ne çalıştı?
text.en: What worked instead of a model in this section?

explanation.en: What is measured is the system around it.

text.en: How are the answer's numbers compared in verification?

tr: Kaynaktaki sayıların listesiyle, kaynak numarası çıkarıldıktan sonra
en: With the list of numbers in the source, after removing the source number

explanation.en: Otherwise "[1]" itself would count as a claim.

text.en: How did the capstone system do on questions with no answer?

en: It said "not found" for all three

explanation.en: Abstention recall 1.00.

text.tr: Bir bileşeni değiştirmeden önce ne yapılır?
text.en: What is done before changing a component?

tr: Mevcut sistem değerlendirme kümesinde ölçülüp kaydedilir
en: The current system is measured and recorded on the evaluation set

explanation.en: After the change it is compared on the same set.

text.tr: Bitirme sisteminin aramasında kaç makale seçiliyor?
text.en: How many articles does the capstone system's search pick?

tr: 1: en ilgili makale; sonra onun cümleleri
en: 1: the most relevant article; then its sentences

explanation.en: As many sentences as fit the token budget.

text.en: What is this section's main idea?

tr: Parçalar bir sistemde birleşir ve sistem ölçülerek iyileştirilir
en: The pieces come together in a system, and the system is improved by measuring
There is no need to measure

explanation.en: Mask → search → verify → log → measure.
